# estravon_bench

> Apples-to-apples PDF-to-Markdown engine comparison for estravon-backend

## Modules

- [estravon_bench.client](https://tiberavonltd.github.io/estravon-backend-benchmarks/client.html.md): Thin HTTP client for one `estravon-backend` instance, plus local-subprocess orchestration -- one process per engine, since each running `estravon-backend` instance is pinned to a single engine (see its own docs) and this package is what drives several of them side by side for a comparison.
- [estravon_bench.compare](https://tiberavonltd.github.io/estravon-backend-benchmarks/compare.html.md): Fan out one PDF across N engines and collect a `ComparisonResultList`. Two modes: spawn local pinned instances (Mode A), or point at a pre-existing `{engine: url}` map of already-running instances (Mode B).
- [estravon_bench.overhead](https://tiberavonltd.github.io/estravon-backend-benchmarks/overhead.html.md): Separating fixed per-request overhead from real per-page processing time, by measuring at several page counts instead of just one.
- [estravon_bench.saas_probe](https://tiberavonltd.github.io/estravon-backend-benchmarks/saas_probe.html.md): Free-by-default reachability/quota probes for Mistral, Datalab, and Replicate -- for answering "is it them or is it me" before trusting a `compare()` run against an engine that's behaving strangely.
